title: LanceDB, which makes a multimodal lakehouse for AI training, built on the open format Lance, raised a $57.5M Series B led by Bessemer and Innovation Endeavors (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE: LanceDB, which makes a multimodal lakehouse for AI training, built on the open format Lance, raised a $57.5M Series B led by Bessemer and Innovation Endeavors — LanceDB Inc., the developer of database technology designed to speed up artificial intelligence models, today announced …
